text: Inside these vibrant, creative spaces, I find myself reflecting on the relationship between order and innovation. The glass and angular lines outside contrast with the colorful, energetic exhibition inside. My curiosity is piqued by the displays about research and development. I feel mildly disoriented by the slant of my view, as if the usual grounding of perspective has shifted—perhaps mirroring how innovation upends stability. I am alert, inquisitive, and a little off-balance, pondering what new paths of thought are opening up around me.
